top_signals.title: Saudi Arabia Halts Energy Sites as Houthis Claim New Attacks
top_signals.summary: Saudi Arabia halted several energy facilities in the south, as the Iran-backed Houthi militants claimed fresh strikes on the kingdom.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Jaguar Land Rover to cut 4,000 jobs over two years in major cost-saving drive
top_signals.summary: The luxury carmaker is targeting £1.7 billion ($2.3 billion) in savings as it faces Chinese competition, a cyberattack and U.S. tariffs.
